results.question: How long after signing can a draft rookie be traded?
results.answer: A Draft Rookie who signs a Standard NBA Contract cannot be traded before thirty (30) days following the date on which the contract is signed [Article VII, Section 8(d)].

results.question: How often can a team use the Bi-annual Exception?
results.answer: A team cannot use the Bi-annual Exception in any two consecutive Salary Cap Years, meaning it can only be used at most once every two Salary Cap Years [Article VII, Section 6(d)(3)].

results.question: How long can a Bi-annual Exception contract be?
results.answer: The term of a Player Contract signed pursuant to the Bi-annual Exception cannot exceed two (2) Seasons in length, and the remaining term of a contract acquired by assignment under this exception also cannot exceed two (2) Seasons in length [Article VII, Section 6(d)(2)].

results.question: How long can a Non-Taxpayer Mid-Level contract be?
results.answer: A Player Contract signed or acquired by assignment pursuant to the Non-Taxpayer Mid-Level Salary Exception cannot exceed four (4) Seasons in length [Article VII, Section 6(e)(2)].
